milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks of the birch fence cluster center (spawn-relative 7, 0, 6) and face toward it. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 per CommonSenseAgent/ValidatorAgent feedback — the fence is ~9 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=5 forces the player to walk at least 4 blocks toward it rather than potentially satisfying the condition from spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks of the TNT stack center (spawn-relative 10, 0, 10) and face toward it. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 per CommonSenseAgent/ValidatorAgent feedback — the TNT is ~14.5 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=5 forces the player to walk at least 9.5 blocks toward it, ensuring meaningful navigation.

Uses inventory_has because mining gray concrete with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The diamond pickaxe is provided in the scene. Requiring min_count=4 ensures meaningful mining occurred and provides enough material for the subsequent tower-building task. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly confirms the player possesses the building material needed for the next task.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a tower means placing blocks in the world. The box starts at Y=3 (spawn-relative) to EXCLUDE the pre-existing gray concrete structure which occupies Y=0 to Y=2. This ensures only player-placed blocks are detected. The generous XZ range (-5 to 22) covers the entire buildable area. Requiring min_count=4 confirms a tower of at least 4 blocks tall was constructed above the existing structures.
